cli.intro: nifty — gitmoji-first release tooling for hybrid cargo + npm workspaces
cli.cmd.format: Format Rust with cargo fmt and JS/TS through Oak
cli.cmd.lint: Lint commit subjects and cargo workspace hygiene
cli.cmd.check: Lint commit subjects, cargo workspace hygiene, and fail on errors
cli.cmd.upload: Upload generic assets to GitHub Release or GitHub Pages
cli.cmd.install-native: Stage matrix .node artifacts into platform npm packages
cli.cmd.bump: Align workspace crate and package versions
cli.cmd.publish: Publish workspace npm packages (OIDC or token + TOTP)
cli.cmd.trust: Configure npm Trusted Publisher for workspace packages
cli.cmd.commit: Commit message export, apply, scan, and audit
cli.cmd.commit.export: Export a JSON commit message map template
cli.cmd.commit.apply: Apply commit message edits from a JSON map and update the branch ref
cli.cmd.commit.scan: Scan commit messages for gitmoji and hygiene issues
cli.cmd.commit.audit: Audit commit messages and fail on errors
cli.opt.with-lint: Run commit lint after export and annotate the JSON map with violations
cli.opt.json: Print commit lint output as JSON
cli.opt.errors-only: Only report error-level commit lint diagnostics
cli.cmd.retime: Spread commit timestamps across a date range on a new branch
cli.cmd.retime.root: Retime all commits from repository root through tip
cli.cmd.change-logs: Draft release reference changelogs from git tags
cli.cmd.change-logs.lookup: Look up GitHub user id/login from email or login
cli.opt.from: Start git ref for commit range
cli.opt.to: End git ref for commit range
cli.opt.subject: Lint a single subject string (repeatable)
cli.opt.no-cargo: Skip cargo workspace hygiene rules from cargo cry
cli.opt.release: Upload files from --dir to the GitHub Release for --tag
cli.opt.both: GitHub Release upload and GitHub Pages deploy
cli.opt.from-artifacts: Downloaded CI artifact root (default: native-artifacts or NATIVE_ARTIFACT_ROOT)
cli.opt.name: GitHub Release title
cli.opt.dry-run: Print actions without writing or publishing
cli.opt.refresh: Ignore publish/trust cache and re-check registry
cli.opt.placeholder: Publish never-published workspace packages as 0.0.0 (name claim)
cli.opt.only: Limit trust to one package name
cli.opt.path: Path to commit JSON map (default: commit.pending.json)
cli.opt.start-date: Random window start (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime)
cli.opt.message: Optional new message for the root commit (retime root)
cli.opt.tags: List version tags with short hashes
cli.opt.fetch: Fetch missing numeric id from GitHub API
